item.title: Italian cycling team shot at by passing driver in horror attack, as squad condemns “motorists’ aggression against cyclists”
item.description: The S.C. Padovani Polo Cherry Bank riders were training in northern Italy, near Lake Garda, when the shocking incident took place, the motorist firing two shots at the group before fleeing the scene

item.title: Scribe promises its wheels are the “ultimate upgrade without the elite price tag”, plus more cool things from Look, Wahoo, Assos and Coospo
item.description: ​Race-ready carbon wheels, smarter indoor training, budget bike computers, winter-ready kit and cleat tech - here’s the cycling gear we’re testing over the festive period

item.title: “Common sense isn’t that common”: Ice cream van owner has meltdown over bikes blocking door… after parking beside cycle racks
item.description: “No wonder Jeremy Clarkson hates cyclists,” the fuming gelato merchant posted, whipping up tension with the town’s cycling community

item.title: Santini Unico Bib Tights
item.description: Very comfortable almost-tights that work well in UK conditions (except rain) 8/10

item.title: “This is why drivers hate us”: Fuming Mini driver goes off-road to overtake huge group of cyclists, as “entitled” riders accused of “blocking whole road”; Van der Poel vaper “plain stupid”; Strava “shambles”; Ineos junior team link + more on the live blog
item.description: It’s Ryan Mallon’s last live blog shift before Christmas, so he’ll be spending most of today counting down the hours until he can watch the cyclocross (and the darts) in peace. And sharing some cycling news and views when he can be bothered…

item.title: Want to see your Year In Sport on Strava? You'll now need to pay, but fitness tech giant insists "core benefits remain as accessible as possible"
item.description: Free account holders might have spotted something missing from their Strava feed this year

item.title: The first road.cc Vodcast is now live! Catch our podcast in video form in 2026
item.description: It’s the road.cc Podcast, but now in video form for select episodes

item.title: Fantasy Christmas bikes — 10 legendary bikes from yesteryear featuring Raleigh, Mercier, Legnano + more
item.description: Christmas is nearly here, and Steve has been dreaming of fantasy bikes of old; some he once rode, others he watched in awe from the roadside as a kid, some he’s never set eyes on. Here’s his Christmas dream bike list

item.title: Oscar Onley’s move to Ineos Grenadiers confirmed, as British star says “opportunity to represent the team of my home country was one I couldn’t refuse”
item.description: The 23-year-old Scottish stage racer is set to leave Picnic PostNL following a breakthrough year that saw him finish fourth overall at the Tour de France

item.title: How Cycle to Work was saved: The battle to stop Labour’s Budget spending cap + The year in cycling reviewed
item.description: On a Christmassy edition of the podcast, we go behind the scenes to delve into Labour’s plans to reintroduce a Cycle to Work spending cap (and how it was stopped), while looking back on the biggest cycling stories of 2025
